24 ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTDECLARATION of June, 2019 (this “Declaration"), by the NEW YORK CITY HOUSING AUTHORITY, a public benefit corporation'established under the laws of the State of NewYork,having an office at 250 Broadway, New York, New York 10007, (the “Authority”or the “Declarant"). RECITALS: A. The Authority holds fee title to that certain real property containing remnants of a playground,located in Bronx County,City and State ofNew York,designated as Block 2287, Lot 26 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork(said land being referred to hereinafter as theParcel A Land” and being more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto; and said land, with the improvements thereon, together with any.future replacements, additions, or alterations thereto, and any new improvements constructed thereon, being referred to hereinafter, collectively, as the "Parcel A Premises"; and the Authority, as fee owner of the Parcel A Land being referred to herein as the“Parcel A Owner").  B.' The Authority is also the owner in fee title of certain vacant land, as conveyed by the City ofNew York as of the date hereof, located in Bronx County, City and State of New York, designated as Block 2287, Lot 71 on the Tax Map of the City of New York and in Exhibit B annexed hereto (collectively, the “Parcel B Land", and said land, with the improvements thereon, together with any future replacements, additions, or alterations thereto, and any new improvements constructed thereon, being referred to hereinafter, collectively, as the “Parcel B Premises"and the Authority, as fee owner of the Parcel B Land being referred to herein as the “Parcel B Owner"). C. BGBETANCESHOUSINGDEVELOPMENTFUNDCORPORATION,aNeW York not-for-profit corporation duly organized pursuant to Article XI of the Private Housing Finance Law of the State of New York, having its principal office located at 505 8TH Avenue, 5th Floor , New York, NY 10018 ("HDFC") as nominee for the BG BETANCES LP, .a.limited partnership organized pursuant to the laws of the state of New York, having its principal office at referred to herein jointly and severally as the“Developer”or "Tenant") intend and desire to lease pursuant to that certain Ground Lease with the Authority of even date (the “Ground Lease"), the Parcel A Land and the Parcel B Land, and construct, develop, lease, operate and maintain the Developer Building containing 152 dwelling units, with 151 units affordable to families at or below 60% of area median income, with 47 units set aside for chronically homeless seniors and remaining 104 units available for seniors earning under 50% of area median income, and one. superintendant's unit, and two community facility spaces. D.The Parcel A Land and the Parcel B Land are contiguous along a shared property line for a distance of at least 10 linear feet that meets the definitional requirement of a “zoning lot" 4852-1569-6538.2

as set forth in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective as of December 15,1961, as amended to date, and as the same may hereafter be amended or restated from time to time, hereinafter referred to as the “Zoning Resolution,” Section 12-10. E.. To enable Developer to develop the Developer Building, the Parties wish to declare a single zoning lot comprised ofthe Parcel A Land and the Parcel B Land (the"Combined Zoning Lot") while providing for the Parcel. A Land and Parcel B Land to remain separate tax lots, and accordingly, the Declarant is, concurrently herewith, memorializing, the Combined Zoning Lot pursuant to that certain Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “DZLR") as set forth in Exhibit C annexed hereto. F.． Any new building or buildings constructed on the Combined Zoning Lot shall be known as the “Developer Building". G. The Combined Zoning Lot and the Developer Building shall be known as the "DevelopmentPremises" H. All parties-in-interest (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Combined Zoning Lot (as hereinafter defined) as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of All New York Title Agency, Inc., annexed hereto as Exhibit D and made a part hereof, have executed this Agreement which instruments are intended to be recorded simultaneously with this Declaration. 1. The  Authority  anticipates  retaining  the Unused  Development  Premises Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) J. The Authority desires to have constructed on the Combined Zoning Lot by the Developer the Developer Building, which will utilize more Development Rights than would be permitted if the Parcel A Land or the Parcel B Land were a separate zoning lot (as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution). K. The Developer Building constructed on the Combined Zoning Lot may generate Bonus Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) and the Authority shall retain any such Bonus DevelopmentRights. L.. The Authority, pursuant to this Declaration, shall (i) allocate the Maximum As- Built Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) to the Combined Zoning Lot, which does not include the Bonus Development Rights, (i) reserve the Unused Development Premises Development Rights for the Authority's use, and (ii) otherwise establish and set forth certain rights and obligations of the Parties thereto. M...]  Developer shall have the right to utilize on the Combined Zoning Lot the Maximum As-Built Development Rights for use and incorporation in the Developer Building. N． To achieve these objectives, the Parties (as hereafter defined) wish to establish and set forth the rights and obligations of the Parties to this Declaration with respect to the Combined Zoning Lot, as the same may be further modified or subdivided pursuant to the terms of this Declaration, and wish to provide to the maximum extent possible for each to exercise its rights in the future without having to seek any consent, approval or action from the other Party. 4852-1569-6538.2
